systems.system: Projet d'Accès au service de Télécommunication des Collectivités territoriales: contract approved by Décret n°2022-0379/PT-RM of 27 June 2022 for 9,407,196,295 FCFA, to be executed in twelve months
systems.country_label: Projet d'Accès au service de Télécommunication des Collectivités territoriales

note: The electoral law names communes and mairies only as electoral units and places where lists are deposited. The same gazette carries a decree approving the contract for a project of telecommunication access for the collectivités territoriales, named with its amount and duration and no description of what it does or whom it connects: a systems entry with no class, and no fact.
